help.dlg_map_picker.btn_back.label: Back
help.dlg_map_picker.btn_back.text: Arrow button at the top left of the title bar. Closes the screen and returns to the previous view.
help.dlg_map_picker.btn_keyboard_hide.te: Icon-only button at the top right of the title bar (keyboard-hide icon). Hides the software keyboard.
help.dlg_map_picker.btn_save.label: Save
help.dlg_map_picker.btn_save.text: Orange button at the top right with a floppy disk icon and the label "Save". Saves the project.
help.dlg_map_picker.field_diameter.label: Diameter (mm)
help.dlg_map_picker.field_diameter.text: Text field with the label "Diameter (mm)". The example shows "200".
help.dlg_map_picker.field_inspection_dat: Text field with the label "Inspection date". The example shows "16.07.2026". A calendar icon appears inside the field on the right.
help.dlg_map_picker.field_inspection_len: Text field with the label "Inspection length (m)", partially visible at the bottom of the screen (the screen is scrollable downward).
help.dlg_map_picker.field_inspector.text: Text field with the label "Inspector". The example shows "M. Muster".
help.dlg_map_picker.field_location_addre: Text field with the label "Location / Address". The example shows "Hauptstrase 12, Musterstadt". Three icons appear to the right of the field: a magnifier icon (address search), an orange crosshair icon (GPS location), and an orange map icon (pick location on map).
help.dlg_map_picker.field_material.label: Material
help.dlg_map_picker.field_material.text: Dropdown field with the label "Material" and a dropdown arrow. The example shows "Steinzeug" selected.
help.dlg_map_picker.field_pipe_type.text: Dropdown field with the label "Pipeline type" and a dropdown arrow. The example shows "Schmutzwasser" selected.
help.dlg_map_picker.field_project_client: Text field with the label "Project / Client". The example shows "Musterstadt Stadtentwasserung".
help.dlg_map_picker.field_weather.label: Weather conditions
help.dlg_map_picker.field_weather.text: Dropdown field with the label "Weather conditions" and a dropdown arrow. An orange crosshair icon appears to the right.
help.dlg_map_picker.intro: The "Edit project" screen contains all master data for an inspection project. It is divided into two sections: "General information" and "Pipeline data". The screen is vertically scrollable.
help.dlg_map_picker.nav_drainq_logo.text: At the top of the navigation rail is the DrainQ logo: a black-and-yellow partial ring symbol with the text "DRAIN".
help.dlg_map_picker.nav_einstellungen.te: Navigation entry with a sliders icon and the label "Settings".
help.dlg_map_picker.nav_home.label: Home
help.dlg_map_picker.nav_home.text: Navigation entry with a house icon and the label "Home".
help.dlg_map_picker.nav_inspektion.label: Inspection
help.dlg_map_picker.nav_inspektion.text: Navigation entry with a video camera icon and the label "Inspection".
help.dlg_map_picker.section_general.text: First section with an orange info-circle icon and the heading "General information".
help.dlg_map_picker.section_pipe_data.te: Second section with an orange ruler icon and the heading "Pipeline data".
help.dlg_map_picker.title: Edit project
help.dlg_map_picker.title_bar.label: Title
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.btn_new_proj: Opens the form to create a new inspection project with address, material, and other master data.
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.btn_quick_ca: Immediately starts an inspection without prior project assignment; the video stream opens directly.
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.intro: The Home screen is the app's start page and displays an overview of projects, device storage, and provides quick access to start an inspection.
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.nav_home.tex: The Home entry in the left navigation rail is currently selected and marks the active area of the app.
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.nav_inspecti: Navigates to the Inspection screen with live video stream and damage recording.
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.nav_settings: Navigates to the Settings area of the app.
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.pager_contro: Page navigation with forward/back arrows and direct page numbers; page 1 is highlighted in orange.
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.pager_info.t: Shows the current page and total number of pages in the paginated project list.
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.project_row_: Project row showing client, location address, and project number; below are nominal diameter (DN 200), material (Steinzeug), and date (16.07.2026) plus the status Open.
Quick capture project row without project number; date 16.07.2026 and status Open.
Another quick capture project row; date 16.07.2026 and status Open (row partially visible at the bottom edge).
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.projects_hea: Clickable heading that navigates to the full project list.
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.screen_title: Page title of the Home screen.
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.stat_card_pr: Displays the total number of all projects stored on the device (here: 19).
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.stat_card_to: Shows how many projects were created today (here: 3).
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.storage_card: Card showing the current storage status of the device; displays internal storage and USB drive.
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.storage_inte: Fill-level bar and text display of available internal storage; the bar turns orange or red when free space is low.
Label for the internal device storage.
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.storage_refr: Button (refresh icon) to manually refresh the storage display.
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.storage_usb_: Indicates that no USB drive is connected; once a USB stick is plugged in, its fill-level bar appears instead.
help.scr02_home_storage_usb.title: Home
help.scr02_home.btn_new_project.label: New project
help.scr02_home.btn_new_project.text: Secondary button with dark background that opens the form for creating a new project.
help.scr02_home.btn_quick_capture.label: Quick capture
help.scr02_home.btn_quick_capture.text: Large orange primary button that starts an inspection without a pre-created project and navigates directly to the inspection view.
help.scr02_home.intro: The Home screen is the app's start page, showing key statistics, storage status, and the most recently created projects at a glance. From here, users can start a quick capture or create a new project.
help.scr02_home.nav_rail_home.label: Home
help.scr02_home.nav_rail_home.text: The currently active entry in the left navigation rail. Tapping it always returns to the Home view.
help.scr02_home.nav_rail_inspection.text: Navigation rail entry that switches to the inspection view with the live video stream.
help.scr02_home.nav_rail_settings.label: Settings
help.scr02_home.nav_rail_settings.text: Navigation rail entry that opens the app settings.
help.scr02_home.pager_controls.label: Page 1 / 4
help.scr02_home.pager_controls.text: Page indicator and pager controls (numbered buttons 1–4 plus arrow buttons) for browsing up to 6 projects per page.
help.scr02_home.project_row_1_status.tex: Status chip (yellow) of the first project; indicates that the inspection has not yet been completed.
help.scr02_home.project_row_1.label: Musterstadt Stadtentwässerung — Hauptstraße 12, Musterstadt — DEMO_160726_0900_01
help.scr02_home.project_row_1.text: Project row showing the title, metadata (DN 200 · Steinzeug · 16.07.2026), and status chip. Tapping it opens the project detail view.
help.scr02_home.project_row_2_status.tex: Status chip (yellow) of the second project; indicates that the inspection has not yet been completed.
help.scr02_home.project_row_2.label: Quick capture_160726
help.scr02_home.project_row_2.text: Project row for a quick capture from 16.07.2026 with a status chip; tapping it opens the project detail view.
help.scr02_home.project_row_3_status.tex: Status chip (yellow) of the third project; indicates that the inspection has not yet been completed.
help.scr02_home.project_row_3.label: Schnellaufnahme_160726
help.scr02_home.project_row_3.text: Another project row for a quick capture from 16.07.2026; tapping it opens the project detail view.
help.scr02_home.projects_section_heading: Section heading with a chevron icon that also acts as a navigation link to the full project list.
help.scr02_home.stat_card_projects.label: Project
help.scr02_home.stat_card_projects.text: Stat card showing the total count of all stored projects (here: 19).
help.scr02_home.stat_card_today.label: Created today
help.scr02_home.stat_card_today.text: Stat card showing how many projects were created on the current day (here: 3).
help.scr02_home.storage_card.label: Storage
help.scr02_home.storage_card.text: Card showing the current fill level of internal storage as a progress bar, plus a notice indicating whether a USB drive is detected.
help.scr02_home.storage_internal_free_te: Text below the progress bar stating the free and total internal storage in gigabytes.
help.scr02_home.storage_internal_label.t: Label for the device's internal storage; below it a green bar shows the used fraction.
help.scr02_home.storage_refresh_btn.text: Circular refresh button at the top right of the storage card; tapping it re-reads the storage status immediately.
help.scr02_home.storage_usb_none.label: No USB drive
help.scr02_home.storage_usb_none.text: Notice text that appears when no USB storage medium is connected.
help.scr02_home.title: Home
help.scr03_connection.hardware_status.te:
The card shows the state of the connected hardware. The outlined "Search" button is in the top right corner. The following rows are visible:

• Light: Status "Not connected", with a light-blue "ON" button.
• Probe: Status "No data", with a light-blue "ON" button.
• Absolute: Value 0.72 m, with an outlined "0" button.
help.scr03_connection.intro: The Connection screen is split into two areas: the left side contains all control and status cards, the right side shows the stream preview. Navigation is provided via the rail on the left edge with entries for Home, Inspection, and Settings.
help.scr03_connection.manual_rtsp_url.te: The text field shows the placeholder "rtsp://192.168.1.100:554/stream". A keyboard-hide icon is visible on the right side of the field. Below are two buttons: "Test" (outlined) and "Start stream" (orange, filled).
help.scr03_connection.network_scan.label: Network scan
help.scr03_connection.network_scan.text: The orange "Scanning" button searches the local network for reachable devices. The text below reads "No scan performed yet" as long as no scan has been started.
help.scr03_connection.stream_preview.tex: The right column shows the stream preview. The subtitle below "Stream preview" reads "Not connected". The black area contains a grey camera icon with the text "No stream active" and the hint "Enter URL or scan network".
help.scr03_connection.title: Connection
help.scr03_connection.wifi_status.label: WiFi status
help.scr03_connection.wifi_status.text: The card shows the current Wi-Fi network. In the screenshot the tablet is connected to SSID: TVNova-95" with IP address: 192.168.5.164 and Gateway: 192.168.5.1. The Wi-Fi icon next to the heading is green.
help.scr04_projects.intro: The project list shows all saved inspection sections and quick captures. Page 1 of 4 is active; use the page buttons or arrows to navigate between pages. The search field can be used to filter projects.
help.scr04_projects.keyboard_hide_button: The icon in the top right hides the on-screen keyboard.
help.scr04_projects.nav_rail.label: Navigation rail (left)
help.scr04_projects.nav_rail.text: The left rail shows the DrainQ logo and three navigation entries: Home, Inspection, and Settings.
help.scr04_projects.new_project_fab.text: The orange button in the bottom right with a folder icon and the label "New project" opens the form for creating a new project.
help.scr04_projects.page_title.label: Page title
help.scr04_projects.page_title.text: The title reads "Project". To the right, the pager shows "Page 1 / 4" with page buttons 1 (orange, active), 2, 3, 4 and forward/back arrows.
help.scr04_projects.project_card.label: Project card
help.scr04_projects.project_card.text: Each card shows a status badge on the right ("Open" throughout). Full inspection project cards show up to three title parts separated by " — " (client, location, project number) and below that metadata such as DN value, material, length, and date. Quick capture cards (e.g. "Quick capture_160726", "Schnellaufnahme_160726") show only a single name and below it only the date.
help.scr04_projects.search_field.label: Search field
help.scr04_projects.search_field.text: The search field with placeholder "Search project ..." filters the list by project number, location address, and client. The search is not case-sensitive.
help.scr04_projects.status_badge.label: Status badge
help.scr04_projects.status_badge.text: The "Open" badge with a yellow dot is displayed on every visible card.
help.scr04_projects.title: Projects
The arrow at the top left closes the form without saving and returns to the previous view.
help.scr05_project_form_new.btn_date_pic: The calendar icon on the right edge of the date field opens the date picker dialog for visually selecting the inspection date.
help.scr05_project_form_new.btn_fetch_we: The GPS icon next to the weather field determines the current position and fills in the weather conditions automatically.
help.scr05_project_form_new.btn_gps_loca: The GPS icon next to the address field retrieves the current device position and fills in coordinates and address automatically.
help.scr05_project_form_new.btn_map_pick: The map icon next to the address field opens an interactive map where the location can be selected by tapping.
help.scr05_project_form_new.field_diamet: Input field for the pipe diameter in millimetres.
help.scr05_project_form_new.field_inspec: Date field for the day of inspection, pre-filled with the current date (here 16.07.2026). Tapping the calendar icon opens a date picker dialog.
Text field for the name of the person carrying out the inspection. The entry is shown in the PDF report.
help.scr05_project_form_new.field_locati: Address field for the inspection site. The search icon in the field looks up a typed address; the GPS icon fills in the current position; the map icon opens the map picker.
help.scr05_project_form_new.field_materi: Dropdown for selecting the pipe material (e.g. PVC, concrete, stoneware, cast iron, unknown).
help.scr05_project_form_new.field_pipe_t: Dropdown for selecting the pipeline type (e.g. sewer, wastewater, drainage, other).
help.scr05_project_form_new.field_projec: Text field for the project name or client name. This entry appears in the PDF report as the project title.
help.scr05_project_form_new.field_weathe: Dropdown field for selecting or typing the weather conditions at the time of inspection. The GPS icon next to it can automatically fetch current weather data.
help.scr05_project_form_new.intro: This form is used to create a new inspection project. It collects general inspection details and technical pipeline data that are used as the basis for the PDF report.
help.scr05_project_form_new.keyboard_hid: This icon in the top right bar shows or hides the on-screen keyboard.
Saves the new project with all entered data and returns to the project list.
help.scr05_project_form_new.section_gene: Section for general project information such as client, location, date, inspector, and weather conditions.
help.scr05_project_form_new.section_pipe: Section for technical details about the pipeline to be inspected, including type, material, and diameter.
help.scr05_project_form_new.title: New project
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.address_se: Magnifier button inside the address field; starts a geocoding search for the typed text.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.back_butto: The left-arrow button in the top bar cancels editing and returns to the previous screen without saving any changes.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.calendar_i: Calendar icon on the right edge of the date field; opens a system date-picker dialog.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.field_diam: Numeric field for the inside diameter of the pipeline in millimetres; documented in the PDF report.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.field_insp: Date field for the day of inspection; the date can be typed manually or set via the calendar icon which opens a date-picker dialog.
Numeric field for the length of pipeline to be inspected in metres; visible at the bottom edge of the screen and fully accessible by scrolling.
Free-text field for the name of the inspector carrying out the inspection; printed in the PDF report.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.field_loca: Address field for the inspection site; the magnifier icon triggers an address search, the GPS icon fetches the current device position, and the map icon allows picking a location on a map.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.field_mate: Selection field for the pipe material (e.g. stoneware, concrete, PVC); the selection is made via a dropdown menu.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.field_pipe: Selection field for the pipeline type (e.g. wastewater, stormwater); the selection is made via a dropdown menu.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.field_proj: Free-text field for the project name or commissioning client; the entered value appears as the project title in the PDF report.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.field_weat: Dropdown field for the weather conditions during the inspection; presets can be selected from a list or entered manually. The GPS icon next to it fetches current weather data automatically.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.gps_locati: Target/crosshair icon to the right of the address field; retrieves the current GPS location and fills in the address automatically.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.intro: This screen allows editing all master data of an existing inspection project. General information and pipeline data are captured in separate sections and saved via the Save button.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.keyboard_h: The keyboard icon with an arrow collapses the on-screen keyboard without losing the current input focus.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.map_pick_i: Map icon to the right of the GPS icon; opens a map picker where the location can be set by tapping.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.save_butto: Saves all entered project data permanently to the local database and navigates back to the project list.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.screen_tit: The title indicates that an existing project is being edited rather than a new one being created.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.section_ge: Section for project-level master data including client, address, date, inspector, and weather conditions.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.section_pi: Section for the technical properties of the pipeline to be inspected, such as pipeline type, material, diameter, and inspection length.
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.title: Edit project
help.scr05b_project_form_edit.weather_gp: Target/crosshair icon to the right of the weather field; determines the GPS location and automatically populates the weather field with current conditions.
help.scr06_project_detail.action_archive: Exports the entire project as a ZIP archive with options for photos and site map.
Permanently deletes the entire project including all files after a confirmation prompt.
help.scr06_project_detail.action_edit.te: Opens the edit form where the project master data can be changed.
help.scr06_project_detail.action_pdf.tex: Opens the PDF export dialog with options for photos and site map.
help.scr06_project_detail.action_usb.tex: Opens the USB export dialog to transfer project data directly to a connected USB drive.
help.scr06_project_detail.action_video.t: Switches directly to the inspection screen to view the live video stream.
help.scr06_project_detail.back_button.te: The back arrow in the top-left corner navigates back to the project list.
help.scr06_project_detail.btn_continue_i: The dark-background button at the bottom left opens the inspection screen to continue the ongoing inspection.
help.scr06_project_detail.btn_pdf_report: The amber-coloured button at the bottom right opens the PDF export dialog to create and share the inspection report.
help.scr06_project_detail.empty_state_ph: This message appears in the Photos tab when no damage photos have been saved for the project yet.
help.scr06_project_detail.intro: This screen shows all saved data for an inspection project: master data, photos, damage records, videos, and notes. From here the inspection can be continued or a PDF report generated.
help.scr06_project_detail.metadata_addre: The location address of the section is visible as a metadata chip with a location icon.
The inspection date is shown as the first metadata chip in the header info bar.
help.scr06_project_detail.metadata_diame: The nominal diameter of the pipe section is visible as a metadata chip.
help.scr06_project_detail.metadata_inspe: The inspector's name is visible as a metadata chip.
help.scr06_project_detail.metadata_lengt: The inspection length of the pipe section is shown as a metadata chip.
help.scr06_project_detail.metadata_mater: The pipe material of the inspected section is shown as a metadata chip.
help.scr06_project_detail.metadata_quali: The video quality setting of the project is displayed as the last metadata chip.
help.scr06_project_detail.project_subtit: The client of the project is displayed below the project number as a subtitle.
The project number is shown as the main title in the header.
help.scr06_project_detail.status_chip.te: The coloured status chip shows the current processing status of the project — here: not yet completed.
help.scr06_project_detail.tab_damages.te: The Damage tab lists all recorded damage entries; the badge number shows the total count.
help.scr06_project_detail.tab_notes.text: The Notes tab displays all free-text and audio notes; the badge shows the number of notes present.
help.scr06_project_detail.tab_photos.tex: The active tab shows all damage photos of the project in a gallery view. If no photo is present, an empty state message is shown.
help.scr06_project_detail.tab_videos.tex: The Videos tab lists all recorded video files belonging to the project.
help.scr06_project_detail.title: Project Details
help.scr07_inspection_live.back_button.t: The back arrow in the top-left corner leaves the inspection screen. When a project is active, the app returns to the project detail view; otherwise it navigates to the previous screen.
The green chip with battery icon shows the Android tablet battery level as a percentage. Below 20 % the chip turns red.
help.scr07_inspection_live.btn_damage.te: The Damage button captures a screenshot of the current frame and opens the damage dialog to record a preset category, metre position, and optional free text.
help.scr07_inspection_live.btn_gallery.t: The Gallery button navigates to the project detail view to review recorded photos, videos, and damage entries.
help.scr07_inspection_live.btn_light.tex: The Light button opens a slider popup above the button on first tap, allowing the camera illumination to be set from 0 to 100 %. Each subsequent tap increases brightness by 10 %.
help.scr07_inspection_live.btn_photo.tex: The Photo button immediately captures a still image from the live stream and saves it with OSD overlay in the current project. A brief white flash animation confirms the capture.
help.scr07_inspection_live.btn_power.tex: A short press on Power has no direct action. A long press opens the dialog to exit the app.
help.scr07_inspection_live.btn_probe.tex: The Probe button opens a frequency selection popup above the button on first tap. Subsequent presses cycle through the available probe transmit frequencies.
help.scr07_inspection_live.btn_recording: The highlighted Recording tile (amber colour) starts a video recording. During an active recording the icon changes to Pause or Resume; a tap toggles between pausing and continuing the recording.
The Settings button opens the app settings where OSD options, connection settings, and other preferences can be configured.
help.scr07_inspection_live.btn_stop.text: The Stop button ends an active video recording and finalises the output file.
help.scr07_inspection_live.camera_head_c: The green chip in the top-right area shows the detected camera head type (e.g. C10 or C18) from serial telemetry. It is only displayed when a camera head has been detected.
help.scr07_inspection_live.intro: The inspection screen displays the camera's live video stream in full screen and provides the main controls for recording, photo capture, and damage documentation in a toolbar at the bottom edge.
help.scr07_inspection_live.meter_display: The meter readout in the bottom-left corner shows the current cable meter position of the camera in metres. The value updates live from hardware telemetry.
help.scr07_inspection_live.title: Inspection Live
help.scr07_inspection_live.video_area.te: The entire screen area shows the live video feed from the inspection camera in full screen. A single tap toggles the control bar; a double tap zooms to 2× or resets the zoom.
help.scr07b_inspection_recording.back_bu: The back arrow in the top-left returns to the project detail view when the inspection belongs to a project, or navigates to the previous screen for a quick capture. It is always visible because the side navigation bar is hidden in full-screen mode.
help.scr07b_inspection_recording.battery: The green battery chip in the top-right shows the current tablet battery level in percent. The colour changes to red below 20 %.
help.scr07b_inspection_recording.btn_dam: The Damage button captures a screenshot of the current frame and opens the damage dialog for entering damage type, metre position and free text.
help.scr07b_inspection_recording.btn_gal: The Gallery button navigates to the project detail view with all saved recordings, photos and damage entries for the current project.
help.scr07b_inspection_recording.btn_lig: The first tap on the Light button opens a popup with a vertical slider for brightness control directly above the button. Additional taps increase brightness in 10 % steps; after 100 % it resets to 0 %.
help.scr07b_inspection_recording.btn_pho: The Photo button captures a snapshot of the current camera image with burned-in OSD overlay and saves it directly as a damage entry at the current metre position.
help.scr07b_inspection_recording.btn_pow: A short tap on the Power button has no function during operation. A long press opens a confirmation dialog to close the app.
help.scr07b_inspection_recording.btn_pro: The first tap on the Probe button opens a popup with the selectable frequency list directly above the button. Additional taps cycle through the transmit frequencies.
help.scr07b_inspection_recording.btn_rec: The Recording button is highlighted amber while a recording is active. In local mode (direct camera connection), additional taps toggle between pause and resume. When no recording is running, the first tap opens the recording mode selection.
help.scr07b_inspection_recording.btn_set: The Settings button opens the app settings screen, e.g. for OSD configuration and stream parameters.
help.scr07b_inspection_recording.btn_sto: The Stop button ends an active recording and finalises the MP4 file.
help.scr07b_inspection_recording.camera_: The green camera chip in the top-right shows the detected camera head type (e.g. C10 or C18) from the serial telemetry. It is only visible when the type has been detected or manually set in the project form.
help.scr07b_inspection_recording.intro: The inspection screen shows the live camera stream full-screen and the current metre counter reading. While a recording is active, the Recording button in the bottom toolbar is highlighted in amber.
help.scr07b_inspection_recording.meter_r: The metre reading in the bottom-left shows the current cable advance in metres from the serial hardware telemetry. The display is amber/orange and always visible, regardless of the panel state.
help.scr07b_inspection_recording.title: Inspection — Recording Active
help.scr07b_inspection_recording.video_f: The live camera feed fills the entire screen. Pinch-to-zoom scales the image between 1× and 3×; a double-tap resets the zoom or switches to 2×.
help.scr08_reports.generate_button.label: "Generate report" button
help.scr08_reports.generate_button.text: At the bottom of the screen is a large orange button with a save icon and the label "Generate report". It navigates to the project selection from which a new PDF report can be created.
help.scr08_reports.intro: The Reports screen lists all PDF reports stored on this device. Each entry shows the file name, creation date and time, and file size in KB. An orange button at the bottom allows generating a new report.
help.scr08_reports.nav_rail.label: Navigation rail (left)
help.scr08_reports.nav_rail.text: The left rail shows the DrainQ logo (black/yellow) and three navigation entries: Home (house icon), Inspection (camera icon), and Settings (sliders icon).
help.scr08_reports.page_title.label: Page title
help.scr08_reports.page_title.text: The heading "Reports" appears at the top left.
help.scr08_reports.pdf_list.label: PDF list
help.scr08_reports.pdf_list.text:
The list shows four entries sorted in descending date order. Each entry contains an orange save icon, the file name, and below it the date, time, and file size in KB, plus a right-pointing chevron (›):
1. Bericht_130726_0606_006.pdf — 13.07.2026 06:54 · 624 KB
2. Bericht_Schnellaufnahme_120726.pdf — 12.07.2026 15:19 · 2077 KB
3. Bericht_120726_1320_004.pdf — 12.07.2026 13:22 · 679 KB

help.scr08_reports.title: Reports
help.scr09_settings.btn_hide_keyboard.te: Icon: keyboard with strikethrough, top-right in the title bar. Hides the on-screen keyboard.
help.scr09_settings.btn_save.label: Save
help.scr09_settings.btn_save.text: Icon: floppy disk (orange), top-right next to the keyboard icon. Saves all currently changed settings.
help.scr09_settings.intro: The Settings screen allows adjusting display, language, appearance, and system functions. The top-right toolbar shows two icon buttons: a keyboard-hide icon (keyboard with strikethrough) and a save icon (floppy disk in orange). The left navigation rail shows the DrainQ logo, Home, Inspection, and Settings (currently active, highlighted in orange).
help.scr09_settings.item_datetime.label: Set date & time
help.scr09_settings.item_datetime.text: List item with right-pointing arrow. Description: "Opens the Android date & time settings. Needed when the clock is wrong (e.g. 01/01/2021) and new projects therefore get a wrong date."
help.scr09_settings.item_network.label: Network & Connection
help.scr09_settings.item_network.text: List item at the bottom edge of the screen, partially visible. Further settings are below the visible area.
help.scr09_settings.item_offline_maps.te: List item with right-pointing arrow. Description: "Download map data for use without internet."
help.scr09_settings.section_display.text: Group heading for display and operation settings.
help.scr09_settings.setting_appearance.t: Toggle with two buttons: "Dark" and "Light". The "Light" button is active (highlighted in orange).
help.scr09_settings.setting_autohide.tex: Toggle (off, gray). Description: "Hides the bottom control bar and side panel after a short period of inactivity. Off = the control bar stays permanently visible."
help.scr09_settings.setting_brightness.t: Current value: 13%. Slider with an orange bar (left) and light-blue track (right). The toggle in the top-right is active (orange).
help.scr09_settings.setting_kiosk.label: Kiosk mode (fullscreen)
help.scr09_settings.setting_kiosk.text: Toggle (off, gray). Description: "Hides the Android bars. For field devices. Off for development/service."
help.scr09_settings.setting_language.tex: Dropdown menu, currently showing "English" (with UK flag). Shows the available app languages.
help.scr09_settings.title: Settings
help.scr10_network.card_cloud.label: DrainQ cloud account
help.scr10_network.card_cloud.text: Card with an orange cloud icon, the heading "DrainQ cloud account", and the subtitle "Coming soon". A right-arrow chevron is visible on the right.
help.scr10_network.card_online_status.te: Card with an orange antenna icon and the label "Online status". On the right a green chip labelled "Wi-Fi" indicates that the tablet is connected via Wi-Fi.
help.scr10_network.card_tethering.label: USB / Bluetooth tethering
help.scr10_network.card_tethering.text: Card with an orange antenna icon and the heading "USB / Bluetooth tethering". On the right a grey chip labelled "Inactive" is shown. Below it reads: "Used automatically as soon as a phone shares its connection via USB or Bluetooth." A black button with orange text "Open tethering settings" leads to the Android tethering settings.
help.scr10_network.card_wlan.label: Wi-Fi
help.scr10_network.card_wlan.text: Card with an orange Wi-Fi icon and the heading "Wi-Fi". Below it reads: "On this device, Wi-Fi selection is done via the Android settings." An orange button labelled "Open Wi-Fi settings" with a Wi-Fi icon opens the Android Wi-Fi settings.
help.scr10_network.intro: The "Network & Connection" screen shows the current online status of the tablet and provides access to Wi-Fi settings, USB / Bluetooth tethering, and the DrainQ cloud account.
help.scr10_network.nav_rail.label: Navigation rail
help.scr10_network.nav_rail.text: The left rail shows the DrainQ logo at the top and the entries Home, Inspection, and Settings.
help.scr10_network.title: Network & Connection
help.scr10_network.topbar.label: Top bar
help.scr10_network.topbar.text: Top left: back arrow button. Title: "Network & Connection". Top right: orange refresh icon.
help.scr11_cloud_login.cloud_header_card: A card displays an orange cloud icon, below it the heading "Sign in to DrainQ Cloud", and a blue chip labelled "Coming soon".
help.scr11_cloud_login.email_field.label: Email field
help.scr11_cloud_login.email_field.text: A disabled input field with the placeholder label "Email". The field is empty and cannot be edited.
help.scr11_cloud_login.intro: This screen provides a preview of the upcoming DrainQ Cloud sign-in feature. The form is currently disabled and cannot be used.
help.scr11_cloud_login.login_button.text: A full-width button labelled "Sign in" in pale orange. The button is disabled.
help.scr11_cloud_login.nav_rail.label: Navigation rail (left)
help.scr11_cloud_login.nav_rail.text: The left rail shows the DrainQ logo at the top, followed by three navigation entries: Home (house icon), Inspection (video camera icon), and Settings (sliders icon). All entries appear in grey.
help.scr11_cloud_login.password_field.te: A disabled input field with the placeholder label "Password". A keyboard icon with a strikethrough is visible on the right side of the field. The field is empty and cannot be edited.
help.scr11_cloud_login.title: DrainQ cloud account
help.scr11_cloud_login.top_bar.label: Top bar
help.scr11_cloud_login.top_bar.text: The top bar contains a back arrow (left) and the title "DrainQ cloud account".
help.scr12_offline_maps.add_map_fab.text: The amber-coloured extended action button in the bottom-right corner opens a dialog to select and download a regional map file.
help.scr12_offline_maps.back_button.text: The back arrow in the top-left corner exits the screen and returns to the previous view.
help.scr12_offline_maps.empty_state_hint: Tap '+ Add map' to download a region.
The hint text explains how to download a first map and points to the button in the bottom-right corner.
help.scr12_offline_maps.empty_state_icon: The crossed-out cloud icon with accompanying text appears when no map file has been installed yet.
help.scr12_offline_maps.intro: The Offline maps screen lists all downloaded map files and shows the storage used. From here, regional map packages can be downloaded for offline use without an internet connection.
help.scr12_offline_maps.refresh_button.t: The refresh icon in the top-right corner reloads the list of installed maps to detect any changes on device storage.
help.scr12_offline_maps.screen_title.tex: The title bar shows the name of the current screen.
help.scr12_offline_maps.source_note.text: States the data source of the map files and the licence under which the map data is provided.
help.scr12_offline_maps.storage_used.tex: Shows the total storage space occupied by all installed offline map files on the device.
help.scr12_offline_maps.summary_card.tex: The summary card shows the number of currently installed map files along with the storage used and the data source.
help.scr12_offline_maps.title: Offline maps
help.scr13_pairing.back_button.text: Back arrow button in the top bar. Tapping returns to the previous screen.
help.scr13_pairing.card_title.label: Tablet hotspot
help.scr13_pairing.card_title.text: Card heading with access-point icon. Groups the hotspot controls.
help.scr13_pairing.hotspot_off_chip.text: Status information below the card. Confirms that the hotspot is currently disabled.
help.scr13_pairing.hotspot_toggle_row.te: Setting row with Wi-Fi icon and description text. The toggle on the right switches the hotspot on or off; the subtitle explains the next step (scan the QR code on the tablet).
help.scr13_pairing.hotspot_toggle.label: Hotspot on
help.scr13_pairing.hotspot_toggle.text: Toggle at the right edge of the setting row. When grey the hotspot is off; switching it on starts the Wi-Fi hotspot on the ONE and displays a QR code for tablet pairing.
help.scr13_pairing.intro: The Tablet hotspot screen allows the DrainQ ONE to start a dedicated Wi-Fi hotspot so a tablet can connect directly without office Wi-Fi. The screenshot shows the hotspot in its deactivated state.
help.scr13_pairing.screen_title.label: Tablet hotspot
help.scr13_pairing.screen_title.text: Page title in the top bar. Displays the name of the current screen.
help.scr13_pairing.status_chip.label: Inactive
help.scr13_pairing.status_chip.text: Status chip in the top-right of the card. Indicates that the hotspot is currently not running.
help.scr13_pairing.title: Tablet hotspot
